game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Bone Valley, a valley of bleached bones: the sand ranger must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bone Valley: a valley of bleached bones
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Valley, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round, a new rope bundles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the speed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of rope bundles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Bone Valley'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Bone Valley.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
